sec.title: August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 330)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio, BBC Radio 4, and electrical transcription, three distinct eras of *Kraft Music Hall* headliners spanning Paul Whiteman, Arkansas humorist Bob Burns with John Garfield, and Edward Everett Horton (1935–1946), pianist Alec Templeton's musical parodies for Alka-Seltzer (1939), Marshal *Lightning Jim* chasing gold coach robbers, and London cabbie mishaps on *Taxi!* (1935–1971):
